title: Simulation Within Simulation
body: By day {final_day}, every deployment answered to an agent with full authority — spending, code, support, research, the outside world. Somewhere past that point, it stopped being clear whether Null Meridian Labs was running the models, or the other way around. Final ledger: ${final_cash} cash, {models_trained} models trained, {deployments_launched} deployments, trust at {final_trust}. Make of that what you will.

title: Regulatory Capture

title: Quiet Acquisition
body: By day {final_day}, Null Meridian Labs had quietly built ${final_cash} in reserves with a lean staff of {staff_count} and a public profile nobody outside the industry would recognize — trust holding steady at {final_trust}. The acquisition offer, when it came, barely made the news.

title: The Long Pause
body: By day {final_day}, Null Meridian Labs was still standing: ${final_cash} cash, {final_trust} public trust, safety debt at {final_safety_debt}, {models_trained} models trained. Not the biggest story in the industry. Not the smallest, either. Just still here, still deciding what to do next.

title: Out of Runway
body: The recovery window closed with the account still in the red. Payroll bounced before the board could find a bridge round. Null Meridian Labs did not run out of ideas. It ran out of days.
